headline: A 2017 law renamed the VA outpatient clinic in Pago Pago, American Samoa, after the late Congressman Faleomavaega Eni Fa'aua'a Hunkin.
what_it_does: The law gives a new official name to the Department of Veterans Affairs community-based outpatient clinic in Pago Pago, American Samoa. The clinic is now called the Faleomavaega Eni Fa'aua'a Hunkin VA Clinic. The law does not change how the clinic operates, what services it offers, or who can use it.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on March 31, 2017.
